name: milai-global-reader-reference-v1
question: Does broad family-balanced weak supervision learn state-conditioned evidence selection beyond ordinary linear heads and simple retrieval?
exclusion_scope: All questions in source-qualified label pair, source-v3 and new44-row source audit; whole admitted variants excluded from new training/dev, regardless of review disposition. Not all project historical exposure excluded.
selection_rule: One maximum-step question per family, uniformly selected from sorted eligible IDs. Fixed shuffled family list per difficulty. Nested quotas; every admitted variant. Complete-input exclusions remove whole selected question without replacement.
candidate_view: One label-independent shuffled pool/alias mapping per source row, stable across its state contrasts. Native literal text unchanged.
training_event: question_id; family then question normalized; positive/negative variants remain in same event
label_scope: Native reference weak supervision; no source-semantic gold claim, original answers unchanged; known reviewed questions excluded.
checkpoint_rule: Fixed final epoch2 for all runs, no seed or checkpoint selection. Epoch0/1/2 development curves diagnostic only.
train_evaluation: All fitted training states once at finalepoch2, original unshuffled option view.
learning_curve_scope: Nested family cohorts at equal epochs, so larger cohort has more optimizer updates. Compare architectures only within same cohort/seed/update budget. Not compute-matched sample efficiency.
job_order: families32 then families128; seeds0,1,2; native/linear order alternates by seed. Root runs serially, no automatic retry.
primary_components: best-open complementary acceptance excluding STOP competition
paired source variants and leave-one/complete contrast correctness

downstream_protocol.method_rule: Same finalepoch2 native/linear perseed, fixed4 and adaptive cap4. BM25fixed4, densefixed4 and full20Reader retain independent results/costs.
downstream_protocol.development: All admitted max-step dev question variants used in this cohort, exposed development scope. Source-first semantic review distinct from native reference scoring.
downstream_protocol.reserved_groups: Fixed49groups remain protected until all training and method settings frozen; no candidate body/answer used here. Further history/source eligibility limitations disclosed.
downstream_protocol.external_transfer: Preexisting MemConflict/MEME/LME are disclosed regression, never new blind evidence. Writer D0 kept separate; read labels do not train Writer roots.
downstream_protocol.reader: Keep previously frozen source-only Reader prompt/endpoint/settings. No per-case fixes, retries or judge-based model choice.
downstream_protocol.adoption: Research only. No autonomous STOP or default adoption without source-faithful end-to-end net gain.

limits: Only one eligible maximum-four-step training family after reviewed-question reservation; length/novel-source transfer not guaranteed.
Native reference semantics and mirror-author equivalence remain uncertain.
Registered historical source isolation does not establish complete-history, semantic duplicate or pretraining isolation.
Other worktree jobs remain paused, no restart.
